profile.summary: Aspire Lionel Wilson College Preparatory Academy is a public charter school in Oakland serving students in grades 6 through 12, with a focus on preparing students for college. It is operated by Aspire Public Schools, a nonprofit network of charter schools, and is authorized by Oakland Unified School District.
